description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 6480ee65f252d9829b0c5a49d44c1fa263babfa2 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* ⭐️ Let plugins declare the issues Psalter can fix by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13515
### Fixes
* [7.x] Keep statements of inlined constructor callees: ~15% less wall time and CPU on Laravel (arrayCache=false) by @jarstelfox in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13495
* Fix: crash when a class is named only in a template's bound by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13503
* ✨ Fix param-conditional return taking both branches for `$this`/`static` param types by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13494
* Fix: crash of multi-threaded runs without posix by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13517
* Fix: NoInterfaceProperties on a hooked interface property of an intersection type by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13452
* Fix: whitespace around `|` in docblock types drops union members or invalidates `@method` by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13457
* Fix Psalter ignoring the type of static property fetches by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13529
* Fix: hooked interface properties on intersections with a generic interface or a class by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13530
* Fix crash when scope summaries contain non-UTF-8 strings by @MohannadElemary in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13518
* Fix: class property checks lost on intersections with a hooked interface by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13532
* Fix: Psalter rewrites self/static/parent in static property references when renaming a class by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13533
### Internal changes
* Perf: Avoid quadratic copying when closing dependent classlikes in Populator (~2.5% faster on a big app) by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13508
* chore(baseline): drop the ImplicitToStringCast entry that #11798 made unused by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13507
* Fix PHPUnit plugin diagnostics in self-analysis by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13524
* Perf: Skip building code use edges that are not recorded when consolidating analysed data (~2% faster on a big app) by @alies-dev in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13509
### Other changes
* Fix method name casing in `MissingOverrideAttribute` check by @maximal in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/11798
* Fix CI Windows path by @orklah in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13525


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/compare/7.2.1...7.3.0

detail.readme:
Psalm

[![Packagist](https://img.shields.io/packagist/v/vimeo/psalm.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/vimeo/psalm) [![Packagist](https://img.shields.io/packagist/dt/vimeo/psalm.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/vimeo/psalm) [![Psalm coverage](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm/coverage.svg?)](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm) [![Psalm level](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm/level.svg?)](https://psalm.dev/) Psalm is a static analysis tool for finding errors in PHP applications. [Join the official Psalm news channel](https://t.me/psalmphp) and the Psalm community on [Telegram](https://t.me/psalmphp_community) and [Discord](https://discord.gg/RwH8rEpxt9)! ## Installation To get started, check out the [installation guide](docs/running_psalm/installation.md). ## Live Demo You can play around with Psalm [on its website](https://psalm.dev/). ## Documentation Documentation is available on [Psalm’s website](https://psalm.dev/docs), generated from the [docs](https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/blob/master/docs) folder. ## Support Psalm development You can support Psalm development by requesting a support contract from [Daniil Gentili](https://daniil.it), the only active maintainer of Psalm. Support contracts can cover full integration of Psalm into existing codebases, support for Psalm issues and development of additional Psalm features. See [here »](https://daniil.it) for info, pricing and contact information. ## Interested in contributing? Have a look at [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Who made this Built by Matt Brown ([@muglug](https://github.com/muglug)). Maintained by Daniil Gentili ([@danog](https://github.com/danog)) and Alies Lapatsin ([@alies-dev](https://github.com/alies-dev)). Former maintainers: Orklah ([@orklah](https://github.com/orklah)) and Bruce Weirdan ([@weirdan](https://github.com/weirdan)). The engineering team at [Vimeo](https://github.com/vimeo) have provided a lot encouragement, especially [@nbeliard](https://github.com/nbeliard), [@erunion](https://github.com/erunion) and [@nickyr](https://github.com/nickyr).
